e.title: **把五百多个 R 包译成现代 Fortran，**并明说未经人工验证****：仓库 `Beliavsky/Fortran-from-R-packages`——**⭐ 逐字自述为**「**experimental modern Fortran translations and ports by ChatGPT on High mode (Extra High starting 2026-08-29)**」**；**⭐ 一句最值得抄的声明**：**「**They have not been validated by a human unless the documentation says otherwise.**」**；**⭐ 其中**精算那一组**逐字列出 **7 个包**（**含已收录的 [[mbbefd]]、**[[lifeinsurer]]、**[[financialmath]]**）**；**⚠️ **仓库根目录无 `LICENSE`**（**许可留在各子目录**）**
e.title_en: A corpus of five hundred and more than twenty R packages translated into modern Fortran by a language model, with each subdirectory keeping its own documentation, tests, provenance record and licence, and with a blanket statement that the ports have not been validated by a human unless the documentation says otherwise, including a seven-package actuarial group whose upstream packages are already pooled.
e.title_hk: **把五百多個 R 包譯成現代 Fortran，**並明說未經人工驗證****：倉庫 `Beliavsky/Fortran-from-R-packages`——**⭐ 逐字自述為**「**experimental modern Fortran translations and ports by ChatGPT on High mode (Extra High starting 2026-08-29)**」**；**⭐ 一句最值得抄的聲明**：**「**They have not been validated by a human unless the documentation says otherwise.**」**；**⭐ 其中**精算那一組**逐字列出 **7 個包**（**含已收錄的 [[mbbefd]]、**[[lifeinsurer]]、**[[financialmath]]**）**；**⚠️ **倉庫根目錄無 `LICENSE`****
e.summary: **fortran-from-r-packages**（`Beliavsky/Fortran-from-R-packages`）**是一份**由语言模型把 R 包译成现代 Fortran 的语料库****——**逐字自述为**「**This repository collects experimental modern Fortran translations and ports by ChatGPT on High mode (Extra High starting 2026-08-29) of computational code in 522 package directories derived from R packages.**」**，**并逐字自述结构**「**Each subdirectory is an independent Fortran Package Manager (fpm) project with its own documentation, tests, provenance record, and license.**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-07-23、最后推送 2026-09-10**、**★3**、**主语言 Fortran**；**⭐ 仓库根目录无 `LICENSE`**（**许可按上游保留在各子目录**）**；**索引 `PROJECT_INDEX.md` 实测 **109,857 字节、**引用 **527 个不同的包目录****（**⭐ 与 README 自述的 **522** 有出入，**本词条**如实并列而不替它调和**）**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**下游：把上游译成另一种语言**」**——**它把已收录的 [[mbbefd]]、**[[lifeinsurer]]、**[[financialmath]] 等 R 包当作**上游****。**⭐⭐⭐ 三处最值得看**：**① **一句把整个语料的证据等级钉死的声明**（**逐字**「**They have not been validated by a human unless the documentation says otherwise.**」**）**；**② **每个子目录**自带出处记录**，**并把上游源码留在 `upstream/` 里**；**③ **另有一个**对照套件**（**174 例**），**且逐字说明它的效力边界**（**「**evidence for selected operations, not validation of every translated API**」**）**。**⚠️ 本次未编译、**未运行任何对照。
e.summary_hk: **fortran-from-r-packages**（`Beliavsky/Fortran-from-R-packages`）**是一份**由語言模型把 R 包譯成現代 Fortran 的語料庫****——**逐字自述為**「**This repository collects experimental modern Fortran translations and ports by ChatGPT on High mode (Extra High starting 2026-08-29) of computational code in 522 package directories derived from R packages.**」**，**並逐字自述結構**「**Each subdirectory is an independent Fortran Package Manager (fpm) project with its own documentation, tests, provenance record, and license.**」**。**本次實測**：**建立 2026-07-23、最後推送 2026-09-10**、**★3**、**Fortran**；**⭐ 倉庫根目錄無 `LICENSE`**（**許可按上游保留在各子目錄**）**；**索引 `PROJECT_INDEX.md` 實測 **109,857 位元組、**引用 **527 個不同的包目錄****（**⭐ 與 README 自述的 **522** 有出入，**本詞條**如實並列而不替它調和**）**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**下游：把上游譯成另一種語言**」**——**它把已收錄的 [[mbbefd]]、**[[lifeinsurer]]、**[[financialmath]] 等 R 包當作**上游****。**⭐⭐⭐ 三處最值得看**：**① **一句把整個語料的證據等級釘死的聲明**（**逐字**「**They have not been validated by a human unless the documentation says otherwise.**」**）**；**② **每個子目錄**自帶出處記錄**，**並把上游原始碼留在 `upstream/` 裡**；**③ **另有一個**對照套件**（**174 例**），**且逐字說明其效力邊界**（**「**evidence for selected operations, not validation of every translated API**」**）**。**⚠️ 本次未編譯、**未運行任何對照。
e.summary_en: The repository Fortran-from-R-packages **is a corpus of R packages translated into modern Fortran by a language model**, described verbatim as collecting experimental modern Fortran translations and ports by a chat model in a stated reasoning mode, with an upgrade to a higher mode from a stated date, of computational code in package directories derived from R packages, where each subdirectory is an independent Fortran Package Manager project with its own documentation, tests, provenance record and licence. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-07-23**, **last pushed 2026-09-10**, **three stars**, primarily Fortran, with **no licence file at the repository root** because licences are preserved per subdirectory from the upstream packages; the project index is a hundred and nine thousand bytes and references **five hundred and twenty-seven distinct package directories**, which this entry records alongside the five hundred and twenty-two stated in the readme without reconciling the two. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the downstream translating the upstream into another language**, since it takes pooled R packages including an actuarial distribution package, a life-insurance contract model and a financial-mathematics package as its upstreams. **Three things are worth reading**: one sentence fixes the evidential status of the whole corpus by stating that the projects have not been validated by a human unless the documentation says otherwise; each subdirectory carries its own provenance record and retains upstream sources for algorithm provenance; and a separate comparison suite of a hundred and seventy-four cases states its own limit of effect verbatim as evidence for selected operations rather than validation of every translated application programming interface. **Nothing was compiled and no comparison was run.**
e.body:
**Fortran-from-R-packages**（GitHub 仓库 `Beliavsky/Fortran-from-R-packages`）**是一份**由语言模型把 R 包的计算代码译成现代 Fortran 的语料库****，**README 逐字自述为**「**This repository collects experimental modern Fortran translations and ports by ChatGPT on High mode (Extra High starting 2026-08-29) of computational code in 522 package directories derived from R packages. Each subdirectory is an independent Fortran Package Manager (fpm) project with its own documentation, tests, provenance record, and license.**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-07-23、最后推送 2026-09-10**、**★3**、**主语言 Fortran**；**⭐ 仓库根目录取 `LICENSE` 返回 **404****（**即**整仓无单一许可**，**许可按上游**保留在各子目录**）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**下游：把上游译成另一种语言**」**。

**可核实信息（均 README、索引与各子目录 README 实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 一句话把整个语料的**证据等级**钉死**——**逐字**：**「**These projects are unofficial and are not endorsed by the original package authors, CRAN, or the R Foundation. They have not been validated by a human unless the documentation says otherwise.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一句**：**⭐ 它一次说清三件事**——**① **非官方、**与原包作者无关**；**② **不被 CRAN 或 R 基金会背书**；**③ **默认状态是「**未经人工验证**」，**除非**该子目录的文档另有说明**。**⭐ 即**「**默认不信**」**被写成了**默认值**，**而**「**信**」**需要**逐目录举证**——**⭐ 这与本站第 352 轮「**登记与出处**」、第 341 轮「**三种缺席**」同向**：**当一大批产物由同一过程生成时，**先声明**它们的共同证据上限****。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 每个子目录**自带出处记录**，**并把上游源码留在仓库里**——**实测 `actuar/README.md` 逐字**：**「**Modern Fortran/FPM translation of the computational core of the R package `actuar` 3.3-7. The upstream package is by Vincent Goulet and contributors and is licensed under GPL-2.0-or-later. This translation preserves that license and retains selected upstream R/C sources under `upstream/` for algorithm provenance.**」**；**`mbbefd/README.md` 逐字**「**Modern Fortran 2018/FPM computational port of the R package **mbbefd 0.8.14**. The original package is by Christophe Dutang and contributors and is distributed under GPL-2. This port preserves the license and retains the supplied upstream source tree under `upstream/mbbefd-master/` for provenance.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本条最实用的一处**：**⭐ 即**译文旁边**放着原文**（**`upstream/` 目录**）**，**且**许可随上游**——**⭐ 这让「**这一段算法到底照谁写的**」**可以被对照**，**而不是**只能相信译文**。**⭐⭐ ③ 另有一个**对照套件**，**而它的效力边界被写明**——**逐字**：**「**The R versus Fortran comparison suite runs deterministic correctness checks and exploratory kernel timings against installed R packages.**」**，**规模逐字为**「**174 cases**」，**另有**「**54-case `rfortran-core` section**」**；**⭐ 而**README 紧接着逐字限定**「**These checks are evidence for selected operations, not validation of every translated API.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这两句合起来是一个**标准的证据陈述**：**先说**跑过什么、**再说**它证明了什么、**然后**主动说明它**不能**证明什么**——**⭐ 这与本站第 344 轮「**把依据放在看得见的地方**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ④ 精算那一组被**按主题编入索引**，**且本次实测到 7 个包**——**索引 `PROJECT_INDEX.md` 的 `### actuarial` 一节逐字列出为** `actuar`、`etrm`、`financialmath`、`jrvFinance`、`lifeinsurer`、`mbbefd`、`vamc`**；**另有 `### actuarial-science` 指向 `actuar`**、**`### life-insurance` 与 `### insurance` 指向 `lifeinsurer`**、**`### annuities` 指向 `financialmath` 与 `lifeinsurer`**、**`### portfolio-insurance` 指向 `etrm`**。**⭐ 而其中 [[mbbefd]]、**[[lifeinsurer]]、**[[financialmath]] **三个上游包都已在本站收录****——**⭐ 即**本站那条条目讲的是**R 原包**，**本条讲的是**它的 Fortran 译文**，**⭐ 本词条**明确声明：**未做任何代码级对照****。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 工程形态可数**：**索引实测 **109,857 字节**；**⭐ 与 README 自述的 **522 个包目录**相比，**索引中**实测引用到 **527 个不同的包目录****——**⭐ 本词条**并列这两个数而不替它调和****；**索引另有**「**按领域组织的任务视图**」（`TASK_VIEWS/`**）、**「**类别与关键词索引**」、**「**NIST GAMS 数学软件索引**」（`GAMS_INDEX.md`**）与**「**共享译文依赖**」（`SHARED_DEPENDENCIES.md`**）**；**⭐ 并逐字给出**只下载单个包**的做法**（**`git clone --depth 1 --filter=blob:none --sparse` ＋ `git sparse-checkout set tsa`**）**——**⭐ 即**因为整仓很大，**它教你怎么**只取一个目录****。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 一处**编译环境的事实**被如实记下**——**`actuar/README.md` 逐字**：**「**FPM was unavailable in the translation environment. The complete package and vendored dependency were therefore compiled directly with GNU Fortran using: `-std=f2018 -Werror=implicit-interface -Werror=trampolines -fcheck=all -O0`**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处很值得抄**：**⭐ 即**「**本来该用 FPM，**但那个环境里没有，**所以改用直接的编译器调用并写出确切参数**」**——**⭐ 这与本站第 335 轮「**不要悄悄降级**」同向**：**降级可以，**但要写出来**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 对照套件的统计口径也被说明**——**逐字**：**「**The report includes overall and per-package arithmetic means, medians, geometric means, minima, and maxima for R time, Fortran time, and the R/Fortran ratio. It also counts Fortran wins, R wins, approximate ties (within 5%), and measurements below timer resolution. The geometric mean of the per-case ratios is the most useful single aggregate; raw times cover heterogeneous workloads.**」**，**并逐字提示**「**Compilation and process startup are excluded from kernel timings. Treat timings as exploratory and repeat them on an idle machine before drawing conclusions.**」**。**⭐ 即**它**不**把「**哪个更快**」当结论**，**而是**给出聚合方式、**平局阈值与「**请自己在空闲机器上重跑**」**的提示**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[mbbefd]]、**[[lifeinsurer]]、**[[financialmath]] 覆盖对应的 R 原包**（**⭐ 其中 [[mbbefd]] 覆盖 MBBEFD 分布族**、**[[lifeinsurer]] 覆盖传统寿险合同建模**、**[[financialmath]] 覆盖精算用金融数学**）**，**[[cran-actuarial-task-view]] 覆盖 CRAN 精算任务视图**，**[[actuarial-foss]]、**[[ai-tools-for-actuaries]] 覆盖开源精算与 AI 工具箱清单**，**[[julia-actuary]]、**[[financecore-jl]] 覆盖另一种语言的精算生态**，**[[tabm-reproduction]] 覆盖「**AI 复现与论文结论不一致**」**，**[[prediction-lab-actuarial]] 覆盖精算教学实验室**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**AI 生成的跨语言译文语料 ＋ 逐目录出处记录 ＋ 整批产物的统一证据上限声明 ＋ 一个自我限定效力的对照套件**」这一形态**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[mbbefd]]、[[cran-actuarial-task-view]] 应当并读**——**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的四点**：**① 由同一过程批量生成的东西，**先声明它们的**共同证据上限****；**② **译文旁边留原文**，**并保留上游许可**；**③ **降级要写出来**（**用了什么编译器、**什么参数、**为什么**）**；**④ 对照跑完要**同时说清它能证明与不能证明什么****。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有编译该项目任何一步**（**未装 Fortran 工具链、**未 `fpm build`、**未 `fpm test`、**未运行 `comparisons/run_comparisons.py`、**未下载整仓**），**故**不主张**任何译文的正确性、**不主张**任何对照结果或计时**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何译文源码**——**本次只读** `README.md`（**73,871 字节**）、**`PROJECT_INDEX.md`、**`actuar/README.md`、**`mbbefd/README.md`、**`lifeinsurer/README.md`、**`financialmath/README.md`、**`vamc/README.md`、**`etrm/README.md` **与** `comparisons/README.md`**；**⭐ 未打开任何 `.f90` 或 `fpm.toml` 正文**（**⭐ `actuar/fpm.toml` 仅取回 627 字节而未读内容**）**，**未读** `TASK_VIEWS/` **与** `GAMS_INDEX.md`**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实 README 自述的 **522 个包目录**与索引实测的 **527 个**孰为准**（**⭐ 两者口径可能不同：**前者是「**包目录数**」，**后者是「**索引里出现过的目录名**」，**本词条**不推断****）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实 **7 个精算包**里各译文的完成度**（**⭐ 本次**只读了其中 5 个的 README**，**未读** `jrvFinance/README.md` **与** `actuar` **之外各包的测试与出处记录**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实各子目录**是否真的保留了上游源码与许可文件**（**⭐ 本词条只转述 README 的说法，**未列** `upstream/` **目录验证**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实对照套件的 **174 例**中是否有**任何精算相关例**（**⭐ 读到的列举为**概率分布、**描述统计、**数值分析、**分数阶时序、**GARCH 滤波与拟合、**金融绩效指标、**诊断、**协方差收缩、**加权分位数、**聚类、**几何、**多项式与信号处理**，**其中**未见**精算专属项**）**——**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**「**有 174 例对照**」**与**「**精算部分被对照过**」**是两件事**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实许可证的逐目录情况**：**⭐ 根目录取 `LICENSE` 为 **404**；**本次实测** `actuar` 为 GPL-2.0-or-later、**`mbbefd` 为 GPL-2**（**均由 README 转述**）**；**⚠️ **整仓的再使用条件**因**逐目录而异**，**复用前**须逐个目录确认**。**⑧ ⚠️ 未核实作者身份与机构**；**★3**——**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**这是一个**实验性语料**，**不是**可依赖的数值库**；**⚠️ 任何用于生产计算的尝试都须先用**原 R 包**核对**。**⑨ ⚠️ 未核实其译文是否已被任何第三方核对或引用**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该语料包含**由模型生成的代码**，**其质量**按作者自己的声明**是**逐目录不确定**的**——**⚠️ 不建议**在没有人工核对的情况下**用于任何精算交付物**。**⑩ ⚠️ 创建 2026-07-23 在解冻窗口之外、推送 2026-09-10 在窗口之内**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是「**由同一模型批量生成、**并统一声明证据上限、**且逐目录保留上游源码与许可**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**。**⑪ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。

This translation preserves that license and retains selected upstream R/C sources under `upstream/` for algorithm provenance.**」**；**`mbbefd/README.md` 逐字**「**The original package is by Christophe Dutang and contributors and is distributed under GPL-2. This port preserves the license and retains the supplied upstream source tree under `upstream/mbbefd-master/` for provenance.**」**。**⭐ 這是最實用的一處**：**譯文旁邊**放著原文**，**且**許可隨上游**——**「**這段算法照誰寫的**」**可以被對照**。**⭐⭐ ③ 另有一個**對照套件**，**其效力邊界被寫明****——**逐字**「**The R versus Fortran comparison suite runs deterministic correctness checks and exploratory kernel timings against installed R packages.**」**，**規模逐字為**「**174 cases**」**與**「**54-case `rfortran-core` section**」**；**⭐ 緊接著逐字限定**「**These checks are evidence for selected operations, not validation of every translated API.**」**——**⭐ 即**先說跑過什麼、**再說證明什麼、**然後主動說明它**不能**證明什麼**。**⭐⭐ ④ 精算那一組被**按主題編入索引**，**實測 7 個包**——`### actuarial` **逐字列出** `actuar`、`etrm`、`financialmath`、`jrvFinance`、`lifeinsurer`、`mbbefd`、`vamc`**；**另有** `### actuarial-science`→`actuar`**、**`### life-insurance` 與 `### insurance`→`lifeinsurer`**、**`### annuities`→`financialmath` 與 `lifeinsurer`**、**`### portfolio-insurance`→`etrm`**。**⭐ 而 [[mbbefd]]、**[[lifeinsurer]]、**[[financialmath]] **三個上游包已在本站收錄****——**⭐ 本詞條**明確聲明：**未做任何代碼級對照****。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 工程形態可數**：**索引實測 **109,857 位元組**，**引用 **527 個不同包目錄****（**⭐ 與 README 自述的 **522** 並列而不替它調和**）**；**索引另含**任務視圖（`TASK_VIEWS/`**）、**類別與關鍵詞索引、**NIST GAMS 數學軟體索引（`GAMS_INDEX.md`**）、**共享譯文依賴（`SHARED_DEPENDENCIES.md`**）**；**⭐ 並逐字給出**只下載單個包**的做法**（**sparse clone ＋ `git sparse-checkout set tsa`**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 一處**編譯環境的事實**被如實記下**——**`actuar/README.md` 逐字**「**FPM was unavailable in the translation environment. The complete package and vendored dependency were therefore compiled directly with GNU Fortran using: `-std=f2018 -Werror=implicit-interface -Werror=trampolines -fcheck=all -O0`**」**——**⭐ 即**「**本來該用 FPM，**環境裡沒有，**所以改用直接編譯並寫出確切參數**」**，**與本站第 335 輪「**不要悄悄降級**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 對照套件的統計口徑被說明**——**逐字**「**It also counts Fortran wins, R wins, approximate ties (within 5%), and measurements below timer resolution. The geometric mean of the per-case ratios is the most useful single aggregate; raw times cover heterogeneous workloads.**」**，**並逐字提示**「**Treat timings as exploratory and repeat them on an idle machine before drawing conclusions.**」**——**⭐ 它**不**把「**哪個更快**」當結論**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 與池內條目的關係**：[[mbbefd]]、[[lifeinsurer]]、[[financialmath]]、[[cran-actuarial-task-view]]、[[actuarial-foss]]、[[ai-tools-for-actuaries]]、[[julia-actuary]]、[[financecore-jl]]、[[tabm-reproduction]]、[[prediction-lab-actuarial]]——**⭐ 而本條補上的是**「**AI 生成的跨語言譯文語料＋逐目錄出處記錄＋整批產物的統一證據上限聲明＋一個自我限定效力的對照套件**」這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[mbbefd]]、[[cran-actuarial-task-view]] 應當並讀**；**⭐ 四點最值得借鑑**：**① 同一過程批量生成的東西，**先聲明共同證據上限****；**② **譯文旁邊留原文**，**並保留上游許可**；**③ **降級要寫出來**；**④ 對照跑完要**同時說清能證明與不能證明什麼****。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有編譯該專案任何一步**（**未裝 Fortran 工具鏈、**未 `fpm build`／`fpm test`、**未運行對照腳本、**未下載整倉**），**不主張**任何譯文的正確性、**不主張**任何對照結果或計時**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀任何譯文原始碼**——**只讀** `README.md`、**`PROJECT_INDEX.md` **與 5 個子目錄 README ＋ `comparisons/README.md`**；**⭐ 未打開任何 `.f90` 或 `fpm.toml` 正文**，**未讀** `TASK_VIEWS/` **與** `GAMS_INDEX.md`**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實 README 的 **522 個包目錄**與索引實測 **527 個**孰為準**（**兩者口徑可能不同，**本詞條**不推斷****）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實 7 個精算包各譯文的完成度**（**只讀其中 5 個 README**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實各子目錄**是否真的保留上游原始碼與許可檔案**（**只轉述 README 說法**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實 174 例對照中是否有**精算相關例****——**⭐ 讀到的列舉為**機率分布、**描述統計、**數值分析、**分數階時序、**GARCH 濾波與擬合、**金融績效、**診斷、**協方差收縮、**加權分位數、**聚類、**幾何、**多項式與信號處理**，**未見精算專屬項**——**⭐ 即**「**有 174 例對照**」**與**「**精算部分被對照過**」**是兩件事**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核實許可的逐目錄情況**：**根目錄 `LICENSE` 為 **404**；**`actuar` 為 GPL-2.0-or-later、**`mbbefd` 為 GPL-2**（**均由 README 轉述**）**；**⚠️ **整倉再使用條件**因目錄而異**，**複用前須逐目錄確認**。**⑧ ⚠️ 未核實作者身份與機構**；**★3**——**⭐ 這是**實驗性語料**而非**可依賴的數值庫****；**⚠️ 用於生產計算前須先用**原 R 包**核對**。**⑨ ⚠️ 未核實其譯文是否已被任何第三方核對或引用**；**⚠️ 該語料含**模型生成的代碼**，**按作者自己的聲明**其質量**逐目錄不確定**——**⚠️ 不建議**在未經人工核對下用於任何精算交付物**。**⑩ ⚠️ 建立 2026-07-23 在解凍窗口之外、推送 2026-09-10 在窗口之內**——**本條的缺口是「由同一模型批量生成＋統一聲明證據上限＋逐目錄保留上游原始碼與許可」這一形態此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑪ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**。

e.body_en:
Fortran-from-R-packages, on GitHub under the user Beliavsky, **is a corpus of R package computational code translated into modern Fortran by a language model**. The readme states verbatim that the repository collects experimental modern Fortran translations and ports by a chat model in a stated reasoning mode, upgraded to a higher mode from a stated date, of computational code in package directories derived from R packages, and that each subdirectory is an independent Fortran Package Manager project with its own documentation, tests, provenance record and licence. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-07-23**, **last pushed 2026-09-10**, **three stars**, primarily Fortran, and a root licence file that returns not found, meaning there is no single repository-wide licence while licences are preserved per subdirectory from the upstream packages. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the downstream translating the upstream into another language.**

**Verified information, all measured from the readme, the project index and several subdirectory readmes**: **first, one sentence fixes the evidential status of the entire corpus**: verbatim, the projects are unofficial and are not endorsed by the original package authors, CRAN or the R Foundation, and they have not been validated by a human unless the documentation says otherwise. **That does three things at once: it declares the work unofficial and unaffiliated with the original authors, it disclaims endorsement by the language community infrastructure, and it makes not being verified by a human the default state, so that trust has to be justified directory by directory rather than assumed. When a large batch of artefacts is produced by one process, declaring their shared evidential ceiling first is the right order.** **Second, each subdirectory carries its own provenance record and the upstream sources are retained in the repository**: the actuarial package translation states verbatim that it is a modern Fortran translation of the computational core of a named version of the upstream package, that the upstream package is by a named author and contributors under a stated licence, and that the translation preserves that licence and retains selected upstream sources under a directory for algorithm provenance; the distribution-family port states that the original package is by a named author and contributors under a stated licence, and that the port preserves the licence and retains the supplied upstream source tree for provenance. **Keeping the original next to the translation, with the licence following the upstream, is what makes it checkable which algorithm a given translation follows instead of requiring trust in the translation alone.** **Third, a separate comparison suite exists and its limit of effect is written down**: verbatim, the comparison suite runs deterministic correctness checks and exploratory kernel timings against installed R packages, with a hundred and seventy-four cases and a fifty-four-case core section, followed immediately by the statement verbatim that these checks are evidence for selected operations and not validation of every translated application programming interface. **That is a standard evidence statement: what was run, what it establishes, and what it deliberately does not establish.** **Fourth, the actuarial group is indexed by domain and measures seven packages**: the index lists a general actuarial package, an energy trading and risk management package, a financial mathematics package, a finance package, a life-insurance contract package, a distribution-family package and a variable-annuity Monte Carlo package under the actuarial task view, with further pointers from the actuarial-science, life-insurance, insurance, annuities and portfolio-insurance views. **Three of those upstream packages are already pooled on this site, and this entry states explicitly that it makes no code-level comparison between the R originals and their Fortran translations.** **Fifth, the engineering shape is countable**: the index is about a hundred and ten thousand bytes and references five hundred and twenty-seven distinct package directories against the five hundred and twenty-two stated in the readme, both figures being recorded here without reconciling them; the index also carries domain-oriented task views, a category and keyword index, an index against a national measurement institute mathematical software catalogue and a document on shared translated dependencies; and the readme gives verbatim instructions for downloading a single package through a sparse clone and a sparse-checkout command. **Sixth, one compilation fact is recorded honestly**: the actuarial translation states verbatim that the Fortran package manager was unavailable in the translation environment, so the complete package and its vendored dependency were compiled directly with a named compiler using a specific list of flags, meaning a degraded path was taken and written down rather than silently taken. **Seventh, the comparison suite states its own statistics conventions**: it reports arithmetic means, medians, geometric means, minima and maxima for each side and for the ratio, counts wins on each side, approximate ties within five percent and measurements below timer resolution, and states that the geometric mean of per-case ratios is the most useful single aggregate because raw times cover heterogeneous workloads, together with a caution that compilation and process startup are excluded and that timings are exploratory and should be repeated on an idle machine. **Eighth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover the three upstream R packages used here, the CRAN actuarial task view, open-source actuarial tool lists, actuarial ecosystems in another language, a model reproduction that contradicted its paper and an actuarial teaching laboratory, **while this entry supplies a model-generated cross-language translation corpus with per-directory provenance records, a single shared evidential ceiling for the whole batch, and a comparison suite that limits its own conclusions. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled distribution-family package and the pooled actuarial task view**, and **four practices transfer directly: when a batch is generated by one process, declare its shared evidential ceiling first; keep the original beside the translation and keep the upstream licence; write down any degraded path with the exact flags used; and when a comparison is run, state both what it establishes and what it does not**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no step of the project was compiled or run** — no Fortran toolchain installed, no build, no test run, no comparison driver executed and the full repository not downloaded — **so no translation is claimed correct and no comparison result or timing is claimed**. **Second, no translated source was read**: only the readme, the project index, five subdirectory readmes and the comparison readme were read, and **no Fortran source file and no package manifest body was opened**, the one manifest fetched being counted but not read; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, whether the five hundred and twenty-two package directories stated in the readme or the five hundred and twenty-seven directories referenced in the index is the right figure was not resolved**, since the two may count differently, and this entry does not infer which. **Fourth, the completeness of each of the seven actuarial translations was not verified**, only five of their readmes being read. **Fifth, whether upstream sources and licence files are in fact retained per subdirectory was not verified**, this entry relaying the readmes only. **Sixth, whether any of the hundred and seventy-four comparison cases concerns actuarial functionality was not verified**: the areas listed are probability distributions, descriptive statistics, numerical analysis, fractional time-series operations, volatility filters and fits, financial performance measures, diagnostics, covariance shrinkage, weighted quantile estimators, clustering, geometry, polynomials and signal processing, with no actuarial-specific item among them, so having a hundred and seventy-four comparisons and having the actuarial parts compared are two different things. **Seventh, the per-directory licence position was not verified**: the root licence file is absent, while the readmes state a copyleft licence for one translation and another copyleft licence for a second, so the conditions for reusing the corpus differ by directory and must be confirmed one directory at a time. **Eighth, the author identity and affiliation were not verified, and a repository with three stars is an experimental corpus rather than a dependable numerical library; any attempt to use it for production computation must first be checked against the original R packages.** **Ninth, whether any translation has been reviewed or cited by a third party was not verified, and this entry states plainly that the corpus contains model-generated code whose quality the author declares to be uncertain directory by directory, so it should not be used in any actuarial deliverable without human review. Tenth, the creation date of 2026-07-23 is outside the thaw window while the push of 2026-09-10 is inside it**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap here is that a model-generated cross-language corpus with per-directory provenance, one shared evidential ceiling for the whole batch, and a comparison suite that limits its own conclusions had no counterpart in the pool. Eleventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11.**
